cards.ex: Habitat loss is the biggest threat to many endangered species.
cards.exUz: Habitat yo'qolishi ko'plab yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostidagi turlarga eng katta tahdiddir.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar yashash joyining yo'q bo'lib ketishi, ularning uyi buzilishi.

cards.ex: The panda is an example of an endangered species.
cards.exUz: Panda yo'qolib borayotgan turga misol bo'la oladi.
cards.uzDef: Yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi ostida turgan hayvon yoki o'simlik turi.

cards.ex: Poaching is a serious problem in many African countries.
cards.exUz: Brakonyerlik Afrika mamlakatlarida jiddiy muammo hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Noqonuniy ravishda hayvonlarni ovlash yoki o'simliklarni yig'ish.

cards.ex: More conservation efforts are needed to protect the rainforests.
cards.exUz: Tropik o'rmonlarni himoya qilish uchun ko'proq muhofaza choralari zarur.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatni saqlash va himoya qilish bo'yicha amalga oshirilayotgan harakat.

cards.ex: Dinosaurs died out millions of years ago.
cards.exUz: Dinozavrlar million yillar oldin qirilib ketgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror tur butunlay yo'q bo'lib ketmoq.

cards.ex: Pesticides can disrupt the food chain.
cards.exUz: Pestisidlar oziq-ovqat zanjirini buzishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bir organizmdan ikkinchisiga energiya o'tish jarayoni.

cards.ex: We visited a wildlife reserve last summer.
cards.exUz: O'tgan yozda tabiat qo'riqxonasiga tashrif buyurdik.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar va o'simliklar himoyalangan hudud.

cards.ex: We need to consider the environmental impact of our actions.
cards.exUz: Biz o'z harakatlarimizning ekologik ta'sirini hisobga olishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Inson faoliyatining atrof-muhitga ta'siri.

cards.ex: They are cutting down trees in the Amazon rainforest.
cards.exUz: Ular Amazon o'rmonida daraxtlarni kesib tashlashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Daraxtlarni kesish, o'rmonni yo'q qilish.

cards.ex: We need to clean up the beach after the party.
cards.exUz: Partiyadan keyin sohilni tozalashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitni axlatdan tozalash, obodonlashtirish.

cards.ex: Global warming is causing sea levels to rise.
cards.exUz: Global isish dengiz sathining ko'tarilishiga sabab bo'lmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yer yuzasidagi o'rtacha haroratning ko'tarilishi.

cards.ex: Climate change is a major threat to our planet.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi sayyoramiz uchun asosiy tahdiddir.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq muddatli harorat va ob-havo sharoitlarining o'zgarishi.

cards.ex: We can reduce our carbon footprint by using public transport.
cards.exUz: Biz jamoat transportidan foydalanish orqali uglerod izimizni kamaytirishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Inson faoliyatining atrof-muhitga uglerod chiqindilari orqali ta'siri.

cards.ex: We should all recycle our plastic and paper.
cards.exUz: Biz hammamiz plastik va qog'ozni qayta ishlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Eski narsalarni yangi mahsulotlarga aylantirish.

cards.ex: Renewable energy sources are becoming more affordable.
cards.exUz: Qayta tiklanuvchi energiya manbalari tobora arzonlashib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qayta to'ldiriladigan energiya manbalari (quyosh, shamol).

cards.ex: Sustainable development is essential for our future.
cards.exUz: Barqaror rivojlanish kelajagimiz uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Kelajak avlodlarning ehtiyojlarini qondirishga xalaqit bermasdan, bugungi ehtiyojlarni qondirish.

cards.ex: It's amazing to see these animals in the wild.
cards.exUz: Bu hayvonlarni yovvoyi tabiatda ko'rish juda hayratlanarli.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar yoki o'simliklarning tabiiy yashash joyida.

cards.ex: We need to take action to protect our environment.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhitimizni himoya qilish uchun chora ko'rishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish uchun biror narsa qilish.

cards.ex: Many species are at risk due to deforestation.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina turlar o'rmonlarning kesilishi tufayli xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi ostida bo'lgan.

cards.ex: Overpopulation is putting a strain on natural resources.
cards.exUz: Aholining haddan tashqari ko'payishi tabiiy resurslarga zo'riqish solmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga og'irlik yoki bosim o'tkazmoq.

cards.ex: A disease could wipe out the entire population.
cards.exUz: Kasallik butun aholini yo'q qilib yuborishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay yo'q qilish, qirib tashlash.

cards.ex: That species is on the brink of extinction.
cards.exUz: Bu tur yo'q bo'lib ketish yoqasida turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Qirilib ketish, yo'q bo'lib ketish arafasida.

cards.ex: We need to ramp up our efforts to save the rainforest.
cards.exUz: Biz tropik o'rmonni saqlab qolish uchun harakatlarimizni kuchaytirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning miqdorini yoki tezligini oshirish.

cards.ex: We can't turn a blind eye to environmental destruction.
cards.exUz: Biz atrof-muhitning buzilishiga ko'z yuma olmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani bilib turib e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: We should all try to give back to the community.
cards.exUz: Hammamiz jamiyatga foyda keltirishga harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatga yoki atrof-muhitga foyda keltirish.

cards.ex: More and more people are trying to go green.
cards.exUz: Ko'proq odamlar ekologik bo'lishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhit uchun foydali bo'lgan usulda yashash.

cards.ex: We can offset our emissions by planting trees.
cards.exUz: Biz daraxt ekish orqali chiqindilarimizni qoplashimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Uglerod chiqindilarini kamaytirish yoki qoplash.

cards.ex: Sustainable living is becoming increasingly popular.
cards.exUz: Barqaror hayot tobora ommalashib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga zarar keltirmaydigan hayot tarzi.

cards.ex: We must protect biodiversity for future generations.
cards.exUz: Biz kelajak avlodlar uchun bioxilma-xillikni himoya qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yer yuzidagi turli hayvonlar va o'simliklarni saqlash.

cards.ex: Climate change threatens food security in many regions.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi ko'plab hududlarda oziq-ovqat xavfsizligiga tahdid solmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Aholining yetarli oziq-ovqat bilan ta'minlanganligi.
